scenes.title: Give the phone back and receive the PDF

lines.text: Security has filled in the FOCA Checklist and hands you the phone.
If you are the Airline Representative, your job is to check the checklist and sign it.
There’s no app to install and no account to sign in to.
Tap the orange button to show that you have the phone.
Then check each line that Security has marked.
If anything is wrong, tap ‘Something is wrong’ and give the phone back to Security.
If everything is correct, type your own name and ID or staff number.
Sign in the box with your finger.
If you need to redo your signature, tap ‘Clear’ and sign again.
When the screen asks, give the phone back to Security.
Security signs and saves the record.
The app creates a signed PDF with a Record ID.
AirAsia Security keeps it in a restricted folder and logs the record.
Security emails you a copy of the signed PDF.
